definitions: If you are not alert or quick to take an opportunity, you will miss it.
Delaying action will result in missing out on something desirable.
examples: The concert tickets sold out in minutes; you snooze you lose!
I wanted that last slice of pizza, but I hesitated. Oh well, you snooze you lose.
He didn't apply for the job right away, and now it's filled. You snooze you lose.
synonyms: strike while the iron is hot
